class.name: CgameBVH
class.brief_description: CPU bounding volume hierarchy for ray queries against a triangle soup.

method.name: build
method.description: Builds the hierarchy. [param triangles] holds three vertices per triangle; a trailing incomplete triangle is ignored. Any previous contents are discarded. An empty array produces an empty hierarchy that never reports a hit.

method.name: clear
method.description: Discards the hierarchy and all triangle data.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns build statistics with the keys [code]triangles[/code], [code]nodes[/code], [code]leaves[/code], [code]max_depth[/code], [code]avg_leaf_size[/code], [code]sah_cost[/code] (expected traversal cost relative to the root area) and [code]build_ms[/code].

method.name: get_triangle_count
method.description: Returns the number of triangles the hierarchy was built from.

method.name: intersect
method.description: Finds the closest hit along [code]origin + t * dir[/code] for [code]t[/code] in a small epsilon up to [param t_max]. [param dir] does not have to be normalized, but [code]t[/code] is expressed in units of [param dir]. The result contains [code]hit[/code] ([bool]), [code]t[/code] ([float], equal to [param t_max] on a miss), [code]tri[/code] ([int], index of the triangle in the array given to [method build], or [code]-1[/code]), [code]u[/code] and [code]v[/code] (barycentric coordinates of the hit) and [code]normal[/code] ([Vector3], the geometric normal flipped to face the ray, or zero on a miss).

method.name: is_built
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the hierarchy contains at least one triangle.

method.name: occluded
method.description: Any-hit shadow query. Returns [code]true[/code] if some triangle blocks [code]origin + t * dir[/code] for [code]t[/code] below [param t_max]. Faster than [method intersect] when the closest hit is not needed.
